_comment: Real measured baseline, not a guess - 30 questions (zod.json + zod_vocab.json) against a fresh index built by build_fixture.py from this repo's own code at the commit noted below. score.py fails the check if a PR's MRR drops more than --max-mrr-drop below this. Update via 'python3 score.py --update-baseline' after a deliberate, reviewed ranking change - never to silence a real regression. Re-measured 2026-11-15 from the CI job itself (ubuntu-24.04): the same commit that scored 0.4661 on 2026-10-29 now scores 0.4487 deterministically; pinning the runner image, tree-sitter and pyarrow did not change it, so the shift is in the CI machines, not this repo.
